Hello,

I have encountered a issue with shiny App.

I have an interactive button in the sidebar panel called "chart type" which contains two types of charts: stacked bar and line. And I have 4 tabs in the main panel, stacked bar chart is the default for the first 3 tabs and line chart is the default for the last tab.
My issue is every time I switch from other tabs to the last tab, it will flash a stacked bar for a second then change into a line chart. I know what's going on behind it but I couldn't improve my code to avoid it.
Could anyone have any solutions to it? Thanks.

Chunlei
